discovery._doc: Abaco: the Family Island with the most visitor-facing inventory (fishing tournaments, regattas, Hope Town festivals), announced mostly on Facebook. Eventbrite (the-bahamas--marsh-harbour) and allevents.in/marsh-harbour hold no local inventory on 2026-10-15 (both pad with worldwide online events) - watchlist, not sources. Seeds are probed every discovery run; a seed is adopted only when its reader yields >= adopt_min_events upcoming.
